# SourdoughCalc

> Free sourdough hydration calculator for home bakers. Enter flour weight to get exact water, salt and starter ratios, plus a 50%-100% hydration chart.

https://sourdough-hydrationcalculator.com/
https://sourdough-hydrationcalculator.com/blog/

https://sourdough-hydrationcalculator.com/blog/what-is-hydration/
